title: Casa Luis Barragán
notes: His own house in Tacubaya; UNESCO World Heritage since 2004
address: Gral. Francisco Ramírez 12–14, Ampliación Daniel Garza, Mexico City

detail.intro: Barragán's own house and studio on Calle General Francisco Ramírez in Tacubaya, altered continuously until his death. Its sequence of rooms, roof terrace and garden set out the whole of his mature language. It was inscribed on the UNESCO World Heritage List in 2004 and is open as a museum.
